major_cooldowns.name: Celestial Alignment
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on the global after Force of Nature with Moonfire and Sunfire freshly recast and trinkets and potion going out alongside it, then spend every point of Astral Power inside the 15 seconds; with Whirling Stars stagger the two charges so each one lands on Convoke the Spirits or Force of Nature.

major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Chosen of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: The replacement for Celestial Alignment: open it after Force of Nature with both dots up and trinkets and potion, then spend Astral Power for the full 20 seconds and overlap Convoke the Spirits inside it.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 102560 is the cast id that replaces Celestial Alignment; 394013 is the talent/buff row. Neither was observed in the sampled parse, which played Celestial Alignment.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it inside Celestial Alignment or Incarnation and under 40 Astral Power, at range rather than in melee; on multiple targets only below 8 enemies and before your other Starfalls, and send it early rather than losing a cast when Celestial Alignment is still more than 50 seconds out.

major_cooldowns.name: Force of Nature
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on the global before Celestial Alignment or Incarnation; when those are more than 45 seconds away (30 with Early Spring) pair it with your next Eclipse entry instead, and lead with it on AoE so the treants spread Moonfire to up to 8 targets.

major_cooldowns.name: Fury of Elune
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Playing Keeper of the Grove, cast it just before you enter Eclipse or open Celestial Alignment so its Astral Power is spent inside the window; playing Elune's Chosen, cast it inside Eclipse as fast as it comes up unless you are saving it for a known damage window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 202770 is the castable talent; 211545 is the follow-up beam. Not pressed in the sampled parse.

major_cooldowns.name: Solar Eclipse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter Solar Eclipse when your filler only reaches one or two targets so Wrath is the empowered spell, and avoid capping the shared Eclipse charges; sit outside Eclipse generating Astral Power only when a priority target is roughly 10 seconds out.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id for the Solar half of the shared 32-second Eclipse button. Lunar Calling removes Solar entry entirely for Elune's Chosen builds.

major_cooldowns.name: Lunar Eclipse
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Enter Lunar Eclipse whenever Starfire consistently hits 3 or more targets, and always on Elune's Chosen; keep both Eclipse charges cycling instead of banking them, and before an Eclipse ends either hold Astral Power for the next entry or dump it if you will be outside Eclipse for several seconds.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast id for the Lunar half of the shared 32-second Eclipse button; not pressed in the sampled parse, whose Lunar entries all came from Celestial Alignment granting both states.

defensives.name: Barkskin
defensives.usage_rule: Your default mitigation at 20% damage reduction (30% with Oakskin) that also stops damage pushing back your casts, so spend it on every telegraphed hit rather than saving it.

defensives.name: Survival Instincts
defensives.usage_rule: 50% damage reduction for 6 seconds: hold it for the single largest hit or an overlap Barkskin cannot cover.

defensives.name: Frenzied Regeneration
defensives.usage_rule: Press it for 24% of your health over 3 seconds after taking a chunk of damage; it banks a charge, so do not idle through a full 36-second window of sustained raid damage.

rules.description: Moonfire, Sunfire, Force of Nature, Celestial Alignment
rules.action: Precast two Wrath at about 4 seconds on the pull timer, apply Moonfire and Sunfire, cast Fury of Elune and then Force of Nature, and open Celestial Alignment or Incarnation with your trinkets and potion; then Starsurge down under 40 Astral Power and channel Convoke the Spirits.

rules.description: Force of Nature immediately before Celestial Alignment
rules.action: Cast Force of Nature on the global before Celestial Alignment or Incarnation so the treants and their Moonfires run the whole window; when the big cooldown is more than 45 seconds out (30 with Early Spring), pair Force of Nature with your next Eclipse instead.

rules.description: Convoke the Spirits held for Celestial Alignment
rules.action: Overlap Convoke the Spirits with Celestial Alignment or Incarnation and the Balance of All Things crit window; only send it solo once Celestial Alignment is more than 50 seconds away and you would otherwise lose the cast.

rules.description: Convoke the Spirits below 40 Astral Power
rules.action: Starsurge down under 40 Astral Power before you channel Convoke the Spirits, so the free spenders it rolls are not thrown into a full bar.

rules.description: Wrath never cast at capped Astral Power
rules.action: Never cast Wrath into a full Astral Power bar; spend on Starsurge or Starfall first, even outside Eclipse, and only bank a full bar when you are entering Eclipse on the next global.

rules.description: Wrath as the filler while Eclipse (Solar) is up
rules.action: Build Astral Power with Wrath as your default filler while Eclipse (Solar) is up; the one exception is a deliberate Starfire cast inside Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune to proc the instant Ascendant Eclipses.

rules.description: Touch the Cosmos spent on Starfall or Starsurge
rules.action: Consume every Touch the Cosmos proc before it drops: Starfall whenever you are talented into Starweaver or on 3 or more targets, Starsurge otherwise.

rules.description: Starsurge gives way to Starfall on 3 or more targets
rules.action: Spend on Starfall from 3 targets upward, keep Starsurge for one or two targets, and stop using Starsurge procs entirely at 8 or more enemies.

source_summary: Balance Druid output is built around stacking everything into the Celestial Alignment or Incarnation: Chosen of Elune window: Fury of Elune then Force of Nature go out first, Celestial Alignment follows on the next global with trinkets and potion, and Convoke the Spirits is channelled inside it under 40 Astral Power. Outside that window the spec cycles the 32-second Eclipse charges, entering Solar for one or two targets and Lunar from three up, applying and maintaining Moonfire and Sunfire while outside Eclipse and dumping Astral Power on Starsurge or Starfall while inside it. Astral Power is never capped, free Starweaver and Touch the Cosmos procs are consumed on sight, and Eclipse charges are staggered rather than banked so a window is always available when a priority target appears.
